scope: Proposition 4.1 (Circuit simulation) of the manuscript “Unconditional time lower bounds for Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence” (preprints/Unconditional-time-lower-bounds-for-Weisfeiler-Leman-equivalence-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 133 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5d58d0f7cee1b9ed), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: To such a circuit one can associate an individual-edge arc- consistency instance over F2, with vector dimensions at most two, that has nonempty arc-consistent sets if and only if every test gate is false. If the circuit is specified by gate types indexed by [m]r, connection schemas with product domains and componentwise partial bijections, and seed and test requests that are unions of product domains, then the consistency instance has the same form. A bounded number of gate types, connection schemas, and product requests gives a bounded number of consistency types and edge schemas, independently of m.
